evals.prompt: How does authentication work in this codebase? I need to understand the full auth flow from login to session validation, including how the JWT middleware checks tokens.
evals.expected_output: Identifies auth-related symbols (login route, JWT verify, auth middleware), shows their source with file:line references, and explains the call chain from login to protected route.

evals.prompt: Where is the function that creates a new user in the backend? Show me its source and list every place it's called from so I can see the blast radius before editing it.
evals.expected_output: Locates the user creation function, shows its body with line numbers, and lists the callers (with file:line) so the user can decide on the edit.

evals.prompt: Trace the request flow for fetching a single inspection by ID. I want the full call chain from the HTTP route handler all the way down to the Prisma database query.
evals.expected_output: Traces from the route definition through the controller/service layer to the Prisma call, naming each hop with file:line references.
